_meta.description: Machine-readable baseline manifest for the ISPC reference benchmarks. Built and run via ispc-ref/Makefile (make build-all && make run-all). All ms values are PROVISIONAL (measured under concurrent background build load; min-of-15 timed reps, contention-resistant). Final evaluation re-measures. Every _x4 run dumps the canonical reference output into ref-out/.
_meta.timing: std::chrono::steady_clock, 3 warmup + min-of-15 timed reps, whole-benchmark granularity

Two kernels timed separately: black_scholes (Black-Scholes, CND polynomial approx) and binomial_put (64-step binomial tree). Timed at whole-benchmark granularity = one full pass over all 131072 options per rep; 3 warmup + min-of-15 timed reps each. Non-task ISPC entry points used (black_scholes_ispc, binomial_put_ispc); the *_ispc_tasks launch variants are present in the object but never called.

stencil.checksum: 16983763.935355 (double-accumulated sum over the buffer written on the final iteration t=5, which is Aeven=A[0]. ISPC and serial are bitwise-identical: reldiff 0.000e+00. Both neon targets agree.)
stencil.workload: ISPC example default (examples/cpu/stencil). Grid Nx=Ny=Nz=256, halo width=4, interior [4,252)^3. Iteration range t=[0,6) => 6 leapfrog stencil steps per benchmark call. coef={0.5,-0.25,0.125,-0.0625}. InitData: A0[x,y,z]=(x<Nx/2)?x/Nx:y/Ny; A1=0; vsq=x*y*z/(Nx*Ny*Nz). 19-tap 3-D stencil (radius 3 per axis). Buffers re-initialized before every timed rep (outside the timed region); the timed region is a single loop_stencil_ispc/serial call over all 6 iterations (whole-benchmark granularity). 3 warmup + min-of-15 timed reps.

ao.checksum: 365161.535156 (ISPC neon-i32x4, = ref-out/ao_ispc.bin; double sum of all 786432 output floats). Reported separately because RNG streams differ: ISPC neon-i32x8 = 365228.953125, serial = 365323.546875. All three agree within ~0.044% (max abs diff ~162 of ~365k), so no wild divergence. Output range [0,1] as expected for AO occlusion. The dumped reference is the neon-i32x4 path.
ao.workload: aobench (Syoyo Fujita) procedural scene: 3 spheres + 1 ground plane, ambient occlusion via Monte Carlo. Image 512x512, NSUBSAMPLES=2 (2x2 primary samples/pixel), NAO_SAMPLES=8 (8x8=64 AO rays per hit). Output = RGB float32 buffer of W*H*3 = 786432 floats. 512x512 is the canonical aobench default. RNG is NOT bit-identical (ISPC seed_rng/frandom keyed on programIndex vs serial drand48()), so checksums are close but not equal by design. 3 warmup + min-of-15 timed reps.
